description.value: Poison damage that the dragon deals ignores resistance and immunity to poison damage. It can inflict the poisoned condition even on creatures normally immune to it. When it deals a critical hit, the target is infected with the plague of undeath|WC5E MoM.
If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 9 ([[/damage 2d8 poison]]) and be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn.
When the dragon takes damage of any type but psychic, each creature within 15 feet of the dragon takes 9 ([[/damage 2d8 poison]]).
The dragon can use its Cannibalize. It then makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit:17 ([[/damage 2d10 + 6 piercing]]) plus 13 ([[/damage 3d8 poison]]).
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:13 ([[/damage 2d6 + 6 slashing]]).
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., all targets in reach. Hit:15 ([[/damage 2d8 + 6 bludgeoning]]).

The dragon cannibalizes the corpse of a dragon or humanoid within 10 feet that has been dead for less than a day, regaining 26 (4d12) hit points. Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 60 feet of the dragon and can see it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's save is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to any dragon's cannibalize for the next 24 hours.
The drake uses one of the following breath weapons.

The drake exhales sludge in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 52 ([[/damage 15d6 poison]]) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails their saving throw by 5 or more must make a DC 15 Constitution save or contract the plague of undeath|WC5E MoM. In addition, any humanoid killed by the dreadful breath rises at the start of the dragon's turn as a zombie that is permanently under its command, following its verbal orders to the best of its ability.

The drake exhales shadowy fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw or take 17 ([[/damage 5d6 necrotic]]) at the start of each of its turns and have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, checks, and saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

The dragon can magically polymorph into a humanoid or back into its true form. Its humanoid form always appears to be sickly and half-rotted. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (its choice). In a new form, the dragon retains its alignment, hit points, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action.

In a 30-foot radius of the dragon, bright light becomes dim light and dim light becomes darkness. Any nonmagical light sources within the area have the light they produce suppressed. This effect lasts until the end of the dragon's next turn and moves with the dragon.

Target creature within 120 feet the dragon can see must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, checks, and saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effects on itself on a success.

Each non-undead creature within 30 feet must make a DC 18 Constituion saving throw, taking 13 ([[/damage 3d8 necrotic]]) on a failed save. Until the end of its next turn, whenever the creature makes an attack roll or saving throw, it must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw. A successful save results in half damage and no other effects.

The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ([[/damage 2d6 + 6 bludgeoning]]) and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
